leverage.exposure: A leveraged position is open and it is the only thing in this briefing that can cost a whole matchday. Georg holds a standing offer on Makengo that exceeds his cash, on a Kickbase listing where he is the only bidder, which means it wins unless someone outbids him. It resolves roughly two hours before the lock. Three outcomes exist and only two are acceptable: fund it by selling Bernardo, or withdraw the offer. Doing neither is the default if he does nothing, and it is the expensive one. The two-hour gap between resolution and lock is a real buffer but a thin one, and it assumes he is at his phone. Fund it on sight.

binding_gap: There is no squad hole to fix. Twelve players, eleven placed, three formations legal, no position short. The binding constraint this run is not shape and not spending power, which is ample; it is cash against a commitment already made. Nothing can be bought until the Makengo bid is settled one way or the other.

verdict.headline: One action, and it has not been taken for three runs running: sell Bernardo back to Kickbase, now, to fund the live Makengo bid.
verdict.headline_short: One action, and it has not been taken for three runs running: sell Ber
verdict.detail: One action, and it has not been taken for three runs running: sell Bernardo back to Kickbase, now, to fund the live Makengo bid. Cash is unchanged from the last two runs, so nothing has been done. If the auction resolves this afternoon against an unfunded balance, the balance goes negative at matchday start and MD2 scores zero for the entire squad. Selling back to Kickbase is instant and needs no counterparty, so there is no reason to wait for the deadline. Everything else on the board is noise.

sell.reason: Bernardo is the sale, and this run re-derived it from scratch rather than inheriting it. He is the only single sale that covers the gap on its own and leaves the best eleven intact. Selling Lokonga instead is worse on points and burns the better asset, because the squad would carry six defenders into a game where only five can field. Selling the two cheap bodies together does not raise enough money to be an option at all. Selling Bernardo plus Widmer is worse again. Bernardo alone it is. One correction of emphasis worth stating plainly: he is fit and he is a projected starter at left-back this weekend, so this is a real player being sold for a better one, not a free disposal of a bench-warmer. The upgrade is genuine but modest, and it is being made because the money is needed, not because he is bad. Amoako stays until after the lock, where a sale cannot cost a matchday.

standing.name: Bernardo
standing.why: REPLACES S06z2dd, which is closed only because its 7.048.552 price was pre-tick and is now stale. The case is unchanged: sell Bernardo back to Kickbase to fund the live 9.000.000 Makengo offer, which resolves ~2026-09-04T16:31Z against cash of 4.107.522, a gap of 4.892.478. THE WAITING ARGUMENT IS NOW SPENT AND MUST NOT BE REPEATED. The previous run correctly advised waiting for the 20:00Z tick; that tick has landed (list_market mvud now reads 2026-09-04T20:00:00Z, i.e. the NEXT update is 90 minutes AFTER the MD2 lock at 18:30Z). Bernardo's mv rose 7.048.552 -> 7.156.102, exactly his tfhmvt of +107.550, so the realised gain from waiting was 107.550, not the 160.481 the old estimate projected. From here there is ZERO further upside to delaying: no tick can fall before the deadline and the sale price is frozen at 7.156.102 for the remaining ~19,3h. Any future run that repeats "wait for the tick" is wrong. Kickbase buys back at exactly mv with no counterparty, re-measured three more times this run (Blaswich 2.653.917, Tiago Tomas 9.460.597, Awortwie-Grant 1.892.782 all cleared to Kickbase at mv to the euro). After the sale cash is 11.263.624; after Makengo resolves, 2.263.624, positive. Squad dips to 11 (1GK/4DEF/4MID/2ATT, legal as 4-4-2) for the ~19h between the sale and the auction, then returns to 12 with 5-3-2 optimal. Fielded XI 1395 -> 1423, +28: ap 62 out, ap 90 in. HE IS FIT AND STARTING and this is not an availability sale - re-verified independently this run, magazin.comunio.de dated 03.09.2026 gives the Hoffenheim XI v Dortmund as Baumann - Coufal, Kabak, Hajdari, Bernardo - Wimmer, Avdullahu, Burger - Lemperle, Daghim - Hlozek, with Bernardo at LEFT-BACK, Hranac again absent, and only Prass doubtful; he is absent from the Ligainsider Verletzte-und-Gesperrte table (03.09). Kickbase still carries st 2 timestamped 2026-08-31T14:40:12Z, now ~78h stale and contradicted - do NOT notify on it. Alternatives checked and rejected this run: withdrawing the Makengo bid keeps 1395 and forfeits +28 for nothing; selling Widmer instead costs 29 fielded points and does not raise enough; Lokonga is barred as a keeper by HOLD Hj137mo.

buy.reason: No buy this run, at any price. The structural test that settled the board two runs ago was re-run against the current listings and it still holds: Makengo is the only listing that both resolves before the lock and is worth owning. Everything else either resolves after Georg is already committed, in which case it cannot add a single point to this matchday, or fails on price, fitness or a complete absence of any points record. The one new listing since the last run is an attacker with no points at all whose auction ends the day after the lock. Three older listings that had never been rejected by name are closed out in the ledger this run so no future run wastes time on them.
